notablePrerequisites: Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's last ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Unbender Tine and Chromatic Orrery.
Holding priority, activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.
